challenges.title: ERO minimum wage, night allowance and PSA standards

items.title: ERO minimum wage since July 2025
items.text: The Employment Regulation Order of the Security Industry Joint Labour Committee (S.I. No. 326/2025) raised the minimum wage on 22 July 2025 from €14.50 to €15.41 per hour.

items.title: €20 night allowance since 2026
items.text: Since 1 January 2026, an allowance of €20.00 per night shift applies — hard to calculate correctly by hand across many sites and changing shifts.

items.title: PSA licence & standards inspection
items.text: As part of the Licensing Standards, PSA auditors check whether ERO employment conditions are being met — non-compliance can lead to findings in the licensing process.

solutions.title: How Klacks takes the load off security services in Ireland
solutions.subtitle: From covered posts to correct night allowances — it all fits together.

items.title: Sites & posts, gap-free
items.text: Every post across every site — Klacks flags every open slot instantly and fills it automatically on request.

items.title: ERO minimum wage applied automatically
items.text: Klacks calculates using the current ERO rate of €15.41 per hour and updates future increases centrally.

items.title: Night allowance calculated correctly
items.text: The €20.00 allowance per night shift, in place since 1 January 2026, is set up as a fixed amount per shift and is factored in automatically — no manual recalculating required, with no percentage-based detour.

items.title: PSA standards kept in view
